title: Andy Reid: I didn't see a false start on Jaylon Moore at end of game

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Andy Reid: I didn't see a false start on Jaylon Moore at end of game
sources.description: The Chiefs blew an 11-point lead in the fourth quarter of Sunday's game against the Broncos, but they were able to drive back into position to try for a game-winning touchdown in the final seconds.
